task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Convene the Department of State Affairs to coordinate the six ministries and issue standing orders to regional governors
Take immediate census of the sick and dead in afflicted prefectures; open granaries and release relief silver for the afflicted; suspend tax collection in stricken counties
Deploy garrison troops to enforce cordon sanitaire between major cities; seal roads and waterways to prevent further contagion and to keep the dead from being transported
Promulgate and enforce quarantine ordinances within cities: punish those who flee afflicted areas, hoard medicine or grain, or conceal illness; prosecute profiteers
Convert suitable government buildings into pest houses and isolation wards; dispatch carpenters and masons to repair wells, drains, and burial grounds
Recruit, appoint, and dispatch imperial physicians and medical officials to the hardest-hit prefectures; requisition local doctors and pharmacists into service
